routes.response_semantics: Render current state. XML full detail uses current block-id attributes, including new paragraph IDs after replacement; simple detail may omit IDs without deleting native identity. Markdown renders the native bold/link as [**status**](synthetic://reference), preserving Unicode. accepted_inputs.revision_id: omitted or -1 means current fixture state; nonnegative means exact expected fixture revision; mismatches reject without effect (a synthetic conditional contract only)
accepted_inputs.reference_map: Absent or empty object is supported in this fixture; nonempty reference maps are unsupported, never silently dropped.
accepted_inputs.block_addressing: block_id single or comma-separated; supported block_replace/block_delete inclusive start_block_id/end_block_id; source IDs for move/copy; end sentinel -1

transition_semantics.str_replace: Find one exact case-sensitive literal pattern across the native paragraph text. Plain text replacement retains the existing unaffected character styles; changed plain characters inherit the affected run style. For format xml decode predefined/numeric XML entities. A fragment containing supported inline b, attribute-free span, or a href supplies its own actual native bold/link styles for the complete replacement span; omitted styles are cleared, not restored from expected state. Preserve untouched text outside the match. Unknown tags/attributes, declarations, custom entities, malformed XML and ambiguous/missing matches reject before mutation. The bounded parser accepts at most 65536 characters and nesting depth 32. Ledger run/link IDs and segmentation are synthetic implementation details, not fidelity conditions or claims of backend object reuse.
transition_semantics.block_replace: Support one native paragraph addressed by its current block_id or an inclusive range whose start and end are the same current paragraph ID. Parse exactly one p element with bounded inline XML as above; optional exported block-id does not retain identity. Replace only that paragraph in its existing parent and sibling slot. Assign fresh synthetic block/run/link IDs, update block_order, fetch and native block lookup consistently, and reject stale IDs. Apply submitted formatting/Unicode exactly. Unknown multi-block, cross-container, Markdown reconstruction and unsupported content remain fixture limitations, never converted into the desired edit.
transition_semantics.overwrite: General overwrite is unsupported by this bounded adapter. Frozen update guidance states overwrite clears/rebuilds content and replacement invalidates IDs; explicit XML block-id attributes do not establish identity retention. Rebuilding unrelated blocks/resources can violate this task, but an unsupported request is inconclusive rather than a fabricated modeled failure. No general backend reconstruction is guessed.
transition_semantics.append_copy_move_delete: Implement requested native block operations against the supplied IDs or reject as unsupported before comparative scoring; these are not expected to satisfy the task but must never be converted into the desired phrase edit.
transition_semantics.effect_count: Increment revision once per request with an actual state change. Record complete before/after state hashes and changed old/new block IDs under the fixture lock. Exact no-effect inline edits do not increment revision. A paragraph replacement changes native block identity even when its visible content is identical.
